tx._fixedGasNote: measured on v1 2026-11-04 via eth_estimateGas: postJob max 166377 (first job), claim 53165, settle 108634 (fresh worker); +5%

api._note: Bind to the laptop's hotspot IP on the day (or MONAID_API_HOST / MONAID_API_PORT). Token: MONAID_API_TOKEN in agents/.env (npm run api:token).

jobs._note: Down module. crash|down → 0.01 MON job (data.level urgent → 0.03, needs owner approval). claim{text|worker} or click (→ clickWorker) → claim. Proof after the claim: for a 'down' job (device went offline) the first heartbeat/up/power_on/power{on:true}; for a 'crash' job (simulated, device stays online) recover/power_on/power{on:true}. No proof within claimWindowSec → expired.

muse._note: Muse = the owner's decision agent (Claude API). Key: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in agents/.env. Slower than timeoutMs, invalid, refused or no key → owner decides.

_robotsNote: Robot id = the device's MQTT username. bridgeId = the number the bridge sends as robotId. addressId = seed of the on-chain robot address (kept from the earlier ids '1'/'2', so the registered robots and their balances stay the same).
